cnn_bn_fuse.note: The BasicBlock's BatchNorm epilogues fused: bn1 apply + relu1 (one launch, the BN output never stored), bn2 apply + identity add + relu2 (one launch), relu1 backward inside bn1's backward reads (the masked gradient never stored). Same words through the same element functions; x_cnn_idn_flags bit 6 routes the glue to x_cnn_batchnorm_forward_fused_m / x_cnn_batchnorm_backward_relu_m. The fused backward fold needs BN_FOLD_BLOCK (the IDENTICAL default); with it off the entry materializes relu's backward and runs the unfused folds.
